items.title: 10.1 Yaksan magnetic field mein current wale conductor par force (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.1 with Figs. 10.2 to 10.4 and Example 10.1 (PDF 230-232); the Fig. 10.2 direction is flagged.

blocks.text: Tajrubati taur par dekha gaya hai ke magnetic field mein rakhe current wale conductor par force lagti hai. Ek seedha conductor lein jis mein mustaqil current hai, jo yaksan magnetic field ke amudi rakha hai, aur current kaghaz se bahar ki taraf hai (Fig. 10.2). Jaise do magnets apni magnetic fields ke zariye ek doosre par force lagate hain, current wale conductor par us ki apni magnetic field aur bairooni magnetic field ke taamul se force lagti hai.

Current ki banai magnetic field aur bairooni yaksan field conductor ki ek taraf ek doosre ko taqwiyat (reinforce) deti hain aur doosri taraf ek doosre ko khatam karti hain. Nateeje mein conductor us taraf chalta hai jahan field kamzor ho; kitab ki Fig. 10.2 mein yeh baen taraf hai. Yun force F conductor aur magnetic field dono ke amudi hai.

blocks.title: Fleming ka left-hand rule
blocks.text: Apna baya haath is tarah rakhein ke pehli ungli (shahadat ki ungli) magnetic field ki simt mein aur doosri (darmiyani) ungli current ki simt mein ho; tab angootha force ki simt batayega (Fig. 10.3). Force ki simt right-hand rule se bhi maloom ho sakti hai: daen haath ki ungliyan current se magnetic field ki taraf chhote zawiye se moriye; khula angootha force ki simt batata hai.

Tajrubati taur par magnetic field mein rakhe conductor par force ki miqdar conductor mein current I, conductor ki lambai L aur bairooni magnetic field ki taqat B ke seedhe tanasub mein hai. Magnetic field ki taqat ko magnetic induction B bhi kehte hain, jis ki simt field ki simt hai. Yun magnetic field B ke amudi rakhe, current I wale, lambai L ke conductor par force F, BIL ke tanasub mein, ya F = kBIL. SI units mein k = 1, lihaza F = BIL ... (10.1).

blocks.title: Magnetic induction (field strength) B
blocks.text: Eq. 10.1 se B = F/IL: magnetic field ki taqat adadi taur par us force ke barabar hai jo magnetic field ke amudi rakhe, ek ampere current wale, ek metre lambe conductor par lagti hai. B ki SI unit tesla (T) hai: 1 T = 1 N A^-1 m^-1. Magnetic induction vector miqdar hai jis ki simt magnetic field ki simt hai.

Hum ek vector L bhi le sakte hain jis ki miqdar conductor ki lambai ke barabar aur simt current ke bahao ki taraf ho. Agar conductor magnetic field se zawiya theta banaye to L ka B ke amudi juz, yaani L sin theta, istemal karte hain (Fig. 10.4). Tab Eq. 10.1 ban jati hai F = BIL sin theta ... (10.2). Vector shakal mein F = I L x B ... (10.3). Equation 10.2 dikhati hai ke force zyada se zyada (BIL) hai jab conductor field ke amudi ho (theta = 90 degrees) aur sifar jab conductor field ke saath ho (theta = 0).

Zameen ki magnetic field taqreeban dipole jaisi hai, ek farzi bar magnet jaisi jis ka magnetic south pole jughrafiyai (geographic) shimali pole ki taraf aur magnetic north pole jughrafiyai junoobi pole ki taraf hai (Interesting Information).

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: N aur S poles ke darmiyan kaghaz se bahar current wala taar, ek taraf kamzor aur doosri taraf taqatwar field, aur kamzor taraf force. Oopar darmiyan: Fleming ka left-hand rule, force, field aur current ke teen amudi teeron ki shakal mein. Oopar daen: field ki taraf rukh wale raqbe, 60 degrees wale aur field ke saath lete raqbe se flux. Neeche: N turns wali coil jis se field lines guzarti hain, aur current se ek chalte charge tak ka qadam.
blocks.caption: Magnetic field mein current par force, magnetic flux aur flux linkage (Figures 10.2 se 10.9 aur topics 10.1 se 10.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Current wale taar ki apni gol magnetic field hoti hai; ek taraf yeh magnet ki field ko khatam karti aur doosri taraf barhati hai, to taar kamzor taraf dhakela jata hai, current aur field dono ke amudi. Fleming ka left-hand rule simt batata hai: pehli ungli field ke saath, doosri ungli current ke saath, angootha force ke saath. Force B I L sin theta ke barabar hai. Kisi raqbe se flux B A cos theta hai, theta field aur raqbe ke amud ka zawiya: sab se zyada jab raqba field ki taraf rukh kare aur sifar jab field ke saath lete. N turns wali coil ka flux linkage ek turn ke flux ka N guna hai. Current chalta hua charge hai, to field ke aar paar chalta ek charge q v B sin theta mehsoos karta hai.

blocks.title: Example 10.1
blocks.text: 10.0 A current wala 20.0 cm lamba taar 0.30 T ki yaksan magnetic field mein rakha hai. Agar taar magnetic field ki simt se 40 degrees ka zawiya banaye to taar par force ki miqdar nikalein. Hal: L = 20.0 cm = 0.20 m, I = 10.0 A, B = 0.30 T, theta = 40 degrees. Eq. 10.2 mein rakhne par F = 10.0 A x 0.30 T x 0.20 m x sin 40 degrees = 0.39 N.

blocks.prompt: 2 m lamba current wala conductor PQ 0.5 T ki magnetic field ke amudi rakha hai aur us par force 1 N hai; current nikalein (numerical 10.12, print mein 7.12). Yaksan field mein current wale conductor par force ka formula nikalein (comprehensive question 10.2).
blocks.explanation: I = F/(BL) = 1/(0.5 x 2) = 1 A; is ki simt kaghaz ke andar force ke liye Fleming ke left-hand rule se milti hai (kitab Q se P deti hai). Force I, L aur B ke tanasub mein hai, F = kBIL aur SI mein k = 1, to F = BIL; zawiya theta par sirf L sin theta field ke aar paar hai, jis se F = BIL sin theta, ya F = I L x B.

items: Magnetic field mein current wale conductor par force lagti hai kyunke us ki apni field ek taraf bairooni field ko barhati aur doosri taraf khatam karti hai; force kamzor taraf, current aur field ke amudi. Fleming ka left-hand rule: pehli ungli field, doosri ungli current, angootha force.
F = BIL (10.1); B = F/IL tesla mein, 1 T = 1 N A^-1 m^-1; F = BIL sin theta (10.2); F = I L x B (10.3); field ke aar paar zyada se zyada, saath sifar. Example 10.1: 0.39 N.
